excerpts.text: The [Nobel Prizes](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nobel_Prize "Nobel Prize") ([Swedish](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Swedish_language "Swedish language"): _Nobelpriset_, [Norwegian](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Norwegian_language "Norwegian language"): _Nobelprisen_) are awarded annually by the [Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Royal_Swedish_Academy_of_Sciences "Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences"), the [Swedish Academy](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Swedish_Academy "Swedish Academy"), the [Karolinska Institutet](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Karolinska_Institute "Karolinska Institute"), and the [Norwegian Nobel Committee](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Norwegian_Nobel_Committee "Norwegian Nobel Committee") to individuals and organizations who make outstanding contributions in the fields of [chemistry](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nobel_Prize_in_Chemistry "Nobel Prize in Chemistry"), [physics](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nobel_Prize_in_Physics "Nobel Prize in Physics"), [literature](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nobel_Prize_in_Literature "Nobel Prize in Literature"), [peace](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nobel_Peace_Prize "Nobel Peace Prize"), and [physiology or medicine](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nobel_Prize_in_Physiology_or_Medicine "Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine").[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Nobel_laureates#cite_note-1) They were established by the 1895 will of [Alfred Nobel](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alfred_Nobel "Alfred Nobel"), which dictates that the awards should be administered by the [Nobel Foundation](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nobel_Foundation "Nobel Foundation").

Different organisations are responsible for awarding the individual prizes; the Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences awards the Prizes in Physics, Chemistry, and Economics; the Swedish Academy awards the Prize in Literature; the Karolinska Institute awards the Prize in Physiology or Medicine; and the Norwegian Nobel Committee awards the Prize in Peace.[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Nobel_laureates#cite_note-3) Each recipient receives a medal, a diploma and a monetary award that has varied throughout the years.[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Nobel_laureates#cite_note-NobelPrizeDescription-2) In 1901, the recipients of the first Nobel Prizes were given 150,782 [SEK](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Swedish_krona "Swedish krona"), equivalent to 10.8 million SEK in 2023.
